column1: # The variants of the parity harness (ADR-draft-parity-harness-with-variants), read by
# scripts/check-parity.sh: edits that make a ported rule fire, applied to a copy of every corpus
# tree they fit and compared there as on the tree itself. One row per variant, five fields
# separated by tabs: a name of [a-z0-9-], the rule ID it makes fire, the path it edits, and
# "sed" with an extended sed expression or "delete" with "-". A sed edit fits a tree when it
# changes the file; a variant that fits no tree fails the harness, and so does one on which
# bash reports no finding of its rule.
# docs/adr-index, docs/adr-numbering, docs/adr-header: checks 1, 2, and 7 of check-docs.sh.
